dst_rule.zh: 实行夏令时（新南威尔士州随全国东部大部分州10月至次年4月使用AEDT）

founded_year.zh: 1987年4月1日（澳大利亚联邦议会立法批准，六个州级交易所合并组建Australian Stock Exchange Limited）；最早可追溯渊源为1871年悉尼证券交易所（Sydney Stock Exchange）成立
founded_year.en: 1 April 1987 (Australian Stock Exchange Limited formed by Act of the Australian Parliament, amalgamating six independent state-based stock exchanges); earliest traceable predecessor is the Sydney Stock Exchange, formed in 1871
founded_year.detail:
1987年合并的六家州级交易所分别位于悉尼(1871)、墨尔本、布里斯班(1884)、阿德莱德(1887)、
霍巴特(1882)、珀斯(1889)。2006年与悉尼期货交易所(Sydney Futures Exchange)合并后，
机构更名为"Australian Securities Exchange"（现"澳大利亚证券交易所"译名的直接来源），
法定名称为"ASX Limited"，见 history 字段。

sources.title: History（ASX 官网）

founded_year.quote: 1871 - The Sydney Stock Exchange formed and continued to operate until it merged with the other five state-based exchanges to form the Australian Stock Exchange on 1 April 1987. ... The Australian Stock Exchange Limited was formed in 1987 after the Australian Parliament passed legislation enabling the amalgamation of six independent state-based stock exchanges.

history.zh: 1987年六州交易所合并成立Australian Stock Exchange Limited；1998年10月14日成为全球第一家完成公司化改制并直接在自己市场上市的交易所；2006年与悉尼期货交易所合并，更名为Australian Securities Exchange，法定名称ASX Limited；2010年8月起对外统称ASX Group
history.en: Formed 1987 by amalgamation of six state exchanges as Australian Stock Exchange Limited; on 14 October 1998 became the first exchange in the world to demutualise and directly list on itself; merged with the Sydney Futures Exchange in 2006 and renamed Australian Securities Exchange (legal name ASX Limited); known externally as ASX Group from August 2010
history.detail:
2000年起标普(Standard & Poor's)接手ASX指数编制，见 indices 章节；2010年8月起竞争引入
澳洲股票市场（Chi-X Australia等对手方入场），ASX在市场监管上的角色移交ASIC，见
regulation.self_regulatory_org 字段的细分说明。

sources.title: History（ASX 官网）
ASX Group（ASX 官网）

history.quote: The Australian Stock Exchange Limited was formed in 1987 after the Australian Parliament passed legislation enabling the amalgamation of six independent state-based stock exchanges. ... 1998 - ASX became the first exchange in the world to demutualise and directly list on itself on 14 October. ... In 2006 the Australian Stock Exchange merged with the Sydney Futures Exchange to become the Australian Securities Exchange. Its official name is ASX Limited.

organization_form.zh: 公司制（自身上市）：1998年由会员制改制并直接在自己市场挂牌
organization_form.en: Demutualized, Listed: demutualized in 1998 and listed directly on its own market
organization_form.detail: 官网明确称其为全球第一家完成公司化改制并自我上市的交易所，是本项目样本中最早的自我上市案例（早于港交所2000年、纽交所2006年）。

sources.title: History（ASX 官网）

organization_form.quote: 1998 - ASX became the first exchange in the world to demutualise and directly list on itself on 14 October.

self_listed.zh: 是，自身股票在ASX市场上市交易（股票代码ASX）
self_listed.en: Yes, ASX Limited itself is listed and trades on its own market (ticker: ASX)

sources.title: History（ASX 官网）
ASX Group（ASX 官网，"ASX is a listed exchange group"）

self_listed.quote: ASX became the first exchange in the world to demutualise and directly list on itself on 14 October.

market_cap_usd_bn.detail: 本轮未核实到具体统计口径与日期的官方总市值数字，留空。

listed_companies_count.detail: 来自ASX官方博客对S&P/ASX指数体系的说明文（2026年6月更新），属约数、非正式统计公报数字，confidence标medium；另据历史沿革页记载2019年时点为2,200家实体（含各类结构化产品发行人），两个数字口径不完全一致，未核实具体差异原因。

sources.title: S&P/ASX indices 101（ASX 官网博客）

listed_companies_count.quote: It is often seen as a proxy for the ASX 'market' even though the ASX has around 2,000 listed companies.

regulator.zh: 澳大利亚证券及投资委员会（ASIC）
regulator.detail: ASIC同时是市场行为监管者与ASX自身作为上市公司的合规监管者（ASX既是被监管市场运营商，也是ASIC监管下的上市公司）。

sources.title: ASX regulatory framework（ASX 官网）

regulator.quote: ASIC is responsible for the supervision of real-time trading on Australia's domestic markets, including those operated by ASX Group, and for enforcing the laws against misconduct on Australia's financial markets, as well as supervising Australian Financial Service Licence (AFSL) holders.

self_regulatory_org.zh: ASX自身（一线监管，负责监督上市实体遵守《上市规则》、参与者遵守《运营规则》）
self_regulatory_org.en: ASX itself (front-line regulation of listed entities under the Listing Rules and participants under the Operating Rules)
self_regulatory_org.detail: 2010年8月起，实时交易层面的市场监管职能已移交ASIC（见overview.history），ASX保留的一线监管集中在上市合规与参与者合规两块，与港交所模式接近但分工边界更清晰（有专门的ASIC-vs-ASX职责划分官方文件）。

sources.title: Matters regulated by ASIC vs matters regulated by ASX（ASX 官网 PDF）

self_regulatory_org.quote: As the licensed operator of the ASX market, ASX is responsible for monitoring and enforcing compliance by ASX listed entities with their obligations under the Listing Rules.

clearing_regulator.zh: 澳大利亚储备银行（RBA，负责金融稳定标准FSS合规评估）与ASIC（负责清算结算牌照合规评估）双重监管
clearing_regulator.en: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA, assesses compliance with Financial Stability Standards) and ASIC (assesses CS facility licence compliance) — dual oversight

sources.title: ASX regulatory framework（ASX 官网）

clearing_regulator.quote: The RBA has responsibility for assessing whether licensed clearing and settlement facilities, including those operated by ASX Group, have complied with the RBA's Financial Stability Standards ("FSS") and done all other things necessary to reduce systemic risk.

core_laws.zh: 《公司法2001》（Corporations Act 2001 (Cth)），市场牌照见其Part 7.2、清算结算牌照见Part 7.3
core_laws.en: Corporations Act 2001 (Cth); market licensing under Part 7.2, clearing & settlement facility licensing under Part 7.3
core_laws.detail: ASIC另按该法第798G条制定《市场诚信规则》（Market Integrity Rules, MIR），统一适用于全澳所有证券期货市场运营商及其参与者，见market_structure.circuit_breaker字段。

sources.title: ASX regulatory framework（ASX 官网）
Corporations Act 2001（联邦立法数据库，仅目录索引，未逐条核实条文全文）

core_laws.quote: As a licensed operator of markets and clearing and settlement facilities in Australia, ASX has various regulatory obligations under the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth).

foreign_ownership_limit.zh: 无ASX专属外资持股上限；适用全国性外国投资审查框架：私人外资对已上市实体的被动持股一般低于20%无需申报，达到20%「实质利益」门槛且资产总值超过年度指数化货币门槛需向财政部申报；外国政府投资者对上市公司的任何直接投资均须申报（不论比例）
foreign_ownership_limit.en: No ASX-specific foreign ownership cap; governed by the national Foreign Investment Review Framework — passive holdings below a 20% 'substantial interest' threshold generally do not require notification for private foreign investors, subject to indexed monetary thresholds; foreign government investors must notify any direct investment in a listed entity regardless of size
foreign_ownership_limit.detail: 外国投资审查委员会（FIRB）辖属财政部，是全澳统一制度而非ASX自定规则，与港交所「自由港无限制」形成结构性对比。具体货币门槛按年1月1日指数化调整，本次未逐条核实2026年度具体门槛数字，只核实到判断标准本身。

sources.title: Guidance Note 7 - Business Investments（外国投资审查委员会 FIRB，PDF）

foreign_ownership_limit.quote: Foreign persons must notify the Treasurer before acquiring a substantial interest (generally at least 20 per cent) in an Australian entity (an Australian corporation or an Australian unit trust)

disclosure_requirements.zh: 持续披露制度：上市实体一旦知悉对证券价格或价值有重大影响的信息，须立即向ASX披露（Listing Rule 3.1），该义务经《公司法》第674条赋予法定效力；另须按年度/半年度（部分矿业及油气勘探公司另加季度）提交财务报告
disclosure_requirements.en: Continuous disclosure regime: a listed entity must immediately disclose to ASX any information a reasonable person would expect to have a material effect on the price or value of its securities (Listing Rule 3.1), given statutory force by section 674 of the Corporations Act; entities must also lodge annual, half-yearly (and for certain mining/oil & gas entities, quarterly) financial reports

sources.title: Matters regulated by ASIC vs matters regulated by ASX（ASX 官网 PDF）

disclosure_requirements.quote: This is the Listing Rule imposing continuous disclosure obligations on ASX listed entities that is given statutory force by section 674 of the Corporations Act ... Chapter 4 for listed entities to lodge annual, half-yearly and, in some cases, quarterly financial statements and reports with ASX by certain dates

investor_protection.zh: National Guarantee Fund（国家担保基金）为特定类型的结算失败提供补偿保障，本次仅在运营规则条文中确认其存在，未找到专门说明页详述覆盖范围
investor_protection.en: National Guarantee Fund provides compensation cover for certain settlement failures; this round only confirmed its existence via a passing reference in the Operating Rules, no dedicated explainer page was located

sources.title: ASX Operating Rules Section 3（ASX 官网 PDF）

investor_protection.quote: does not constitute a 'reportable transaction' for the purposes of National Guarantee Fund cover

pre_market.zh: 盘前 07:00:00-09:59:00（悉尼时间，随机15秒），经纪商录入订单但不撮合
pre_market.en: Pre-open 07:00:00-09:59:00 Sydney time (randomised 15 secs); orders queued but not matched
pre_market.quote: Pre-opening takes place from 07:00:00 to 09:59:00* (randomised 15 seconds), Sydney time. During Pre-opening: Brokers enter orders into ASX Trade in preparation for the market opening. ASX Trade does not match orders.

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

continuous_am.zh: 开盘单一价格集合竞价09:59:00-09:59:45后转入连续交易，无区分上下午
continuous_am.en: Opening Single Price Auction 09:59:00-09:59:45, transitioning into continuous trading; no AM/PM split
continuous_am.quote: The transition from OSPA to continuous trading (Open) occurs at 09:59:45* (randomised 15 seconds).

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

lunch_break.en: No lunch break; trading is continuous throughout the day
lunch_break.detail: 推断依据：交易时段表从09:59:45连续交易至16:00:00无中断记录，未见专门声明「无午休」的原文，confidence相应降级。

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

continuous_pm.zh: 连续交易09:59:45-16:00:00（悉尼时间），价格/时间优先连续撮合
continuous_pm.en: Continuous trading 09:59:45-16:00:00 Sydney time, continuous matching on price/time priority
continuous_pm.quote: During Normal Trading from 09:59:45* (randomised 15 seconds) to 16:00:00, Sydney time, brokers enter orders into ASX Trade and ASX Trade matches the orders against each other, resulting in trades i.e in this phase ASX Trade automatically matches all trades in Price/Time Priority on a continuous basis.

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

after_market.zh: 16:00起依次经过Pre-CSPA(16:00-16:10)、收盘集合竞价(16:10-16:11)、Post Close(16:11-16:21:30)、Adjust(16:21:30-16:42)等多阶段收盘流程，非单一「盘后连续交易」时段
after_market.en: From 16:00, a multi-phase closing sequence runs: Pre-CSPA (16:00-16:10), Closing Single Price Auction (16:10-16:11), Post Close (16:11-16:21:30), Adjust (16:21:30-16:42) — not a single continuous after-hours session
after_market.quote: Between 16:00:00 to 16:10:00, Sydney time, the market is placed in Pre-CSPA. Continuous matching ceases, brokers can enter, change and cancel orders in preparation for the market closing. The Closing Single Price Auction takes place between 16:10:00^ (randomised 30 seconds) to 16:11:00, Sydney time.

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

night_session.zh: 无正式夜盘；16:42-18:50为Adjust ON阶段，经纪商可电话协商成交（称为overnight trading），须遵守ASX Market Rules保证有序
night_session.en: No formal night session; 16:42-18:50 is the 'Adjust ON' phase during which brokers may negotiate trades by telephone ('overnight trading'), subject to ASX Market Rules to ensure orderliness
night_session.quote: Brokers wishing to trade contact each other by telephone. ASX Market Rules ensure that trading takes place in an orderly fashion. Trading during the Adjust phase is referred to as overnight trading.

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）
Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

opening_mechanism.zh: 开盘单一价格集合竞价（OSPA），09:59:00起随机15秒窗口触发，最早09:59:45转入连续交易
opening_mechanism.en: Opening Single Price Auction (OSPA), triggered within a randomised 15-second window from 09:59:00, earliest transition to continuous trading at 09:59:45

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

opening_mechanism.quote: The Opening Auction takes place at 09:59:00® (randomised 15 seconds), Sydney time. The OSPA session state immediately follows the opening auction. This is a levelling/buffering period which will run for a minimum of 30 seconds.

closing_mechanism.zh: 收盘单一价格集合竞价（CSPA），16:10起随机30秒窗口触发，16:11收盘
closing_mechanism.en: Closing Single Price Auction (CSPA), triggered within a randomised 30-second window from 16:10, closing at 16:11

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

closing_mechanism.quote: The Closing Single Price Auction takes place between 16:10:00^ (randomised 30 seconds) to 16:11:00, Sydney time. ASX Trade calculates closing prices during this phase.

matching_principle.zh: 价格优先、时间优先，连续竞价阶段由ASX Trade系统自动持续撮合
matching_principle.en: Price/time priority, continuously matched automatically by the ASX Trade system during continuous trading

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

matching_principle.quote: ASX Trade automatically matches all trades in Price/Time Priority on a continuous basis.

order_types.detail: 本轮抓取的Operating Rules第三节未包含订单类型的完整定义清单（篇幅未覆盖到该部分），留空待后续核实。

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

tick_size.detail: ASX运营规则中提及交易须为「Price Steps」的整数倍，但具体分档表未在本轮抓取范围内（可能在单独的Procedures文件中），留空。

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

board_lot_size.detail: 未核实ASX是否仍保留传统意义上的标准交易单位/整手概念，留空。

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）
Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

type.zh: 无逐日涨跌幅限制；改用订单级异常订单阈值机制（AOT）作为价格保护手段
type.en: No daily price limit band; ASX instead uses order-level Anomalous Order Thresholds (AOT) as a price safeguard
type.detail: AOT本质是拒绝偏离每分钟更新的基准价±10%以上的激进订单，是订单校验机制而非全天价格区间限制，两者功能定位不同，不应混同为「价格限制」的同类实现。

sources.title: Market volatility FAQs（ASX 官网）

type.quote: ASX does not use circuit breakers like those employed by some other international exchanges. ... These rules include specifications about the use of Anomalous Order Thresholds (AOTs), rather than circuit breakers. ... The AOT Reference Price is updated every minute and prevents the placing of aggressive orders (an order +/-10% the reference price).

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）
Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

circuit_breaker.zh: ASX不使用其他国际交易所常见的熔断机制；ASIC统一制定的市场诚信规则(MIR)改用AOT取代熔断
circuit_breaker.en: ASX does not use circuit breakers as employed by some other international exchanges; ASIC's Market Integrity Rules substitute AOTs for circuit breakers

sources.title: Market volatility FAQs（ASX 官网）

circuit_breaker.quote: Why are circuit breakers not used in Australian exchanges such as ASX? ASX does not use circuit breakers like those employed by some other international exchanges. ASIC applies a common set of market integrity rules (MIRs) for all securities and futures markets in Australia that all local market operators and their participants are required to adhere to.

volatility_interruption.zh: 极端成交区间机制（ETR）：成交价触及每只股票各自设定的区间即暂停该股交易2分钟，与AOT搭配构成组合机制
volatility_interruption.en: Extreme Trade Range (ETR) mechanism: trading in an individual stock is paused for two minutes if price triggers that stock's own ETR band, working alongside AOT
volatility_interruption.detail: AOT-ETR组合被ASX官方定位为在「限制大幅急促价格波动」与「允许自然市场力量引导交易」之间取得平衡的方案，功能上对应其他交易所的个股级波动性中断，但ASX强调这不是circuit breaker。

sources.title: Market volatility FAQs（ASX 官网）

volatility_interruption.quote: We will also pause trading in individual stocks for two minutes if the price triggers the Extreme Trade Range (ETR) mechanism, which is unique for every stock. We believe the AOT-ETR mechanism promotes orderliness by striking a balance between restricting large and sudden price movements, while allowing natural market forces to guide trading.

trading_halt_mechanism.zh: 上市实体可申请交易暂停（trading halt），须说明理由、期望时长及触发恢复交易的预期事件；单次暂停不得超过申请后第二个交易日正常交易开始，ASX亦可依职权在无序市场时强制暂停
trading_halt_mechanism.en: A listed entity may request a trading halt, stating its reasons, desired duration and the expected triggering event for resumption; a single halt cannot exceed the commencement of normal trading on the second trading day after it is requested; ASX may also impose halts on its own initiative to prevent a disorderly market

sources.title: ASX Listing Rules Chapter 17（ASX 官网 PDF）

trading_halt_mechanism.quote: ASX may grant a trading halt at the request of an entity. ... ASX Operating Rule 16.4.2 says that a trading halt can be applied for a period not exceeding the commencement of normal trading on the second trading day following the day on which it is requested.

intraday_reversal.zh: 未见针对当日回转交易（先买后卖）的结构性限制，交易层面近似T+0
intraday_reversal.en: No structural restriction on intraday buy-then-sell found in materials reviewed; effectively T+0 at the trading level
intraday_reversal.detail: 本轮未找到类似上交所T+1式的当日回转禁止条款，判断依据是「未发现限制性规定」而非「找到明确允许条款」，故confidence标medium；结算层面为T+2，两者是不同层面的概念，见clearing.settlement_cycle。

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

short_selling.zh: 覆盖式卖空（covered short selling）合法且受《公司法》认可为价格发现与流动性的正当机制，须遵守披露义务；裸卖空（naked short selling）除ASIC个别豁免情形外一律禁止；覆盖式卖空须于次一交易日上午9点前向市场运营商报告
short_selling.en: Covered short selling is legal and recognised under the Corporations Act as a legitimate mechanism for price discovery and liquidity, subject to disclosure obligations; naked short selling is prohibited except where ASIC has granted relief; covered short sales must be reported to the market operator by 9am on the next trading day
short_selling.detail: 无美式报升规则（uptick rule），不限定特定证券名单，因此归为freely_allowed而非restricted_uptick，核心限制是强制披露与裸卖空禁令而非价格限制。

sources.title: Regulatory Guide 196 - Short Selling（ASIC 官网 PDF）

short_selling.quote: Covered short selling is permitted under the Corporations Act. This recognises covered short selling as a legitimate mechanism for price discovery and liquidity, subject to disclosure and subject to intervention by ASIC in exceptional cases. ... Naked short sales are prohibited except where ASIC has given relief ... to the market operator by 9 am on the next trading day (T+1).

block_trade.zh: 存在Crossings与Special Crossings机制（场内配对成交报告），具体门槛与流程未在本轮抓取范围内详细核实
block_trade.en: Crossings and Special Crossings mechanisms exist for reporting matched trades; specific thresholds and process not fully verified in this round

Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

market_maker_scheme.zh: ETF/权证等投资产品发行人须依AQUA/Warrant规则履行流动性支持（做市）义务；衍生品市场另设正式的做市商注册制度
market_maker_scheme.en: Issuers of investment products (ETFs/warrants) must meet liquidity support (market making) obligations under the AQUA/Warrant Rules; the derivatives market has a separate formal Market Maker registration scheme

sources.title: Matters regulated by ASIC vs matters regulated by ASX（ASX 官网 PDF）

market_maker_scheme.quote: compliance by issuers with their liquidity support requirements for an investment product ... ASX may register a Trading Participant as a Market Maker for one or more Derivatives Market Contracts in accordance with the procedure set out in the Procedures.

connect_schemes.detail: 未见类似沪港通式的跨境互联互通机制；ASX Clear的Trade Acceptance Service(TAS)接受Cboe Australia、National Stock Exchange of Australia等其他本地市场运营商(AMO)的CHESS适格证券交易，属本地竞争市场间的清算互通，非跨境机制，与「互联互通」概念不完全对应，暂不作为该字段的正式内容填入。

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

pre_market.zh: 夜盘（Night Session）与日盘（Day Session）开盘前均设10分钟的「开市前」（Pre-Open）状态：期货/期权合约可在此期间录入买卖盘但不撮合成交，直至转入Open状态后按「均衡价格」（Auction Equilibrium Price）算法一次性撮合未成交余额
pre_market.en: Both the Night Session and Day Session are preceded by a 10-minute Pre-Open state: bids and offers for futures/option contracts may be entered but are not matched until the market transitions to the Open state, when unmatched auction interest is matched at the Auction Equilibrium Price

sources.title: ASX 24 Trading Platform Guide（ASX 官网 PDF）

pre_market.quote: Pre-Open: A period of 10 minutes prior to the Open in respect of a particular Futures Contract or Option Contract during which bids and offers may be entered into the system.

continuous_am.zh: 无「上午/下午」之分：一个交易日（Trading Day）由夜盘（Night Session）与日盘（Day Session）两段组成，夜盘固定先于日盘，可跨越两个日历日；平台以XSFE/NZFX市场为例按24/6近乎全周运作，每周一最早06:20开始首个产品的开市前时段，每周六08:00最后一个产品收盘
continuous_am.en: There is no literal AM/PM split: a Trading Day consists of two sessions — a Night Session that always precedes a Day Session — which can span two calendar days; the Trading Platform operates the XSFE and NZFX markets on a near-continuous 24/6 basis, with the first product's Pre-Open as early as 06:20 each Monday and the last product closing at 08:00 each Saturday

sources.title: ASX 24 Trading Platform Guide（ASX 官网 PDF）

continuous_am.quote: The Trading Platform will operate the XSFE and NZFX markets on a 24/6 basis, with the first product pre-opening at 06:20 each Monday and the last product closing at 08:00 each Saturday. A Trading Day cycle consists of two trading sessions – a Night Session which always precedes a Day Session – on the same Trading Day but across consecutive business days.

lunch_break.zh: 日盘（Day Session）内部为单一连续交易时段，未见独立午休安排
lunch_break.en: The Day Session is a single continuous trading block; no separate lunch break was found
lunch_break.detail: 推断依据：ASX 24合约规格表将日盘列为单一连续区间（如SPI 200为9.50am–4.30pm一段式，中间无间断记录），未见专门声明「无午休」的原文，confidence相应降级，做法与本文件顶层market_structure.lunch_break一致。

sources.title: ASX 24合约规格总表（ASX 官网 PDF）

continuous_pm.zh: 日盘（Day Session）时段：以SPI 200股指期货为例，9.50am–4.30pm（悉尼时间）
continuous_pm.en: Day Session: for SPI 200 Index Futures, 9.50am–4.30pm Sydney time

sources.title: ASX 24合约规格总表（ASX 官网 PDF）

after_market.zh: 无独立的「盘后」连续交易时段；日盘Close之后进入Maintenance（清算/换日）状态，随即衔接下一次夜盘的Pre-Open
after_market.en: There is no separate after-hours continuous trading session; after the Day Session's Close, the platform enters a Maintenance state (order purge / Trade Date roll) before the next Night Session's Pre-Open begins

sources.title: ASX 24 Trading Platform Guide（ASX 官网 PDF）

after_market.quote: Maintenance: Relevant orders are purged. Expired instruments are deleted (including day only UDC contracts) and new instruments are added, the trading business day is incremented and pre-trade risk limits are reset.

night_session.zh: 夜盘（Night Session）时段：以SPI 200股指期货为例，夏令时（每年3月第二个周日至11月第一个周日）为5.10pm–次日7.00am，非夏令时为5.10pm–次日8.00am（均为悉尼时间）；夜盘固定先于日盘，与日盘共同构成一个交易日
night_session.en: Night Session: for SPI 200 Index Futures, 5.10pm to 7.00am the next day during daylight saving (second Sunday in March to first Sunday in November), or to 8.00am the next day outside daylight saving (Sydney time); the Night Session always precedes the Day Session within a Trading Day

sources.title: ASX 24合约规格总表（ASX 官网 PDF）

night_session.quote: 5.10pm – 7.00am and 9.50am – 4.30pm3 (For period from second Sunday in March to first Sunday in November) 5.10pm – 8.00am and 9.50am – 4.30pm3 (For period from first Sunday in November to second Sunday in March)

holidays_note.detail: ASX 24另发布独立的Trading Calendar（如T24-trading-calendar系列PDF），与现货市场假期安排未必一致，本轮抓取范围未覆盖该日历PDF的具体条款，如实留空。

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）

opening_mechanism.zh: 开市前（Pre-Open）时段结束后转入Open状态，未成交的竞价盘按「均衡价格」（Equilibrium Price, EP）算法一次性撮合：算法依次以（1）最大成交量、（2）最小剩余量、（3）市场压力方向（买卖盈余符号）、（4）参照前一成交/结算价 四步择定均衡价
opening_mechanism.en: After the Pre-Open state, the market transitions to Open, where unmatched auction orders are matched at an Equilibrium Price (EP) determined by a four-step algorithm: (1) maximum matched volume, (2) minimum surplus, (3) market pressure (the sign of the surplus), (4) reference to the last traded/settlement price

sources.title: ASX 24 Trading Platform Guide（ASX 官网 PDF）

opening_mechanism.quote: Open: Session where orders on all contract types can be entered, overlapping orders from the Pre-Open (auction) will be matched at the equilibrium price. New orders can be matched and trades can be executed. ⋯ The Auction Equilibrium Price (EP) algorithm calculates potential matched volume and surplus at each overlapping price level and chooses the price that maximises the traded quantity and minimum surplus.

closing_mechanism.zh: 无独立的收盘集合竞价机制（不同于现货市场的CSPA）：Close状态仅代表当日交易结束，不再接受新订单或修改；各合约当日结算价按各自方法论确定（视产品而异，本轮未逐一核实），随后进入Maintenance完成清算与换日
closing_mechanism.en: There is no dedicated closing auction (unlike the cash market's CSPA): the Close state simply means trading for the day has ended and no further order entry or modification is accepted; each contract's daily settlement price is determined by its own product-specific methodology (not exhaustively verified this round), after which the platform enters Maintenance to clear and roll to the next Trade Date

sources.title: ASX 24 Trading Platform Guide（ASX 官网 PDF）

closing_mechanism.quote: Close: Trading day is over and the Market is closed, no orders can be entered or modified at this time.

matching_principle.zh: 价格-时间优先（Price-Time Priority）：连续交易阶段由撮合引擎自动配对买卖盘；修改价格、增加数量或变更账户类型会导致排队优先级重置并生成新的Public Order ID，其余类型的修改不影响原有优先级
matching_principle.en: Price-Time Priority: the matching engine automatically pairs orders during continuous trading; a change in order price, an increase in order size, or a change of account type resets queue priority and generates a new Public Order ID, while other modifications leave existing priority unaffected

sources.title: ASX 24 Trading Platform Guide（ASX 官网 PDF）

matching_principle.quote: The following modifications (if successful) will result in a change of price-time priority and a new Public Order ID: ⋯ All other modifications will not impact price-time priority and the existing Public Order ID will be maintained.

order_types.zh: 两种订单类型：限价盘（Limit）——可扫单成交至限价、未成交部分挂单；「市价转限价」盘（Market-to-Limit）——仅按对手方最优一档价格成交，未成交部分以该价挂单；有效期（Time in Force）含GFD（当日有效）/GTC（取消前有效）/GTD（指定日期前有效）/GTT（指定时间前有效）/FOK（全额成交或取消）/IOC（即时成交、剩余取消）共六种，未指定TIF默认按GFD处理；期权的GTC/GTD/GTT仅适用于双时段期权，不适用于单时段的日内/隔夜期权
order_types.en: Two order types: Limit — sweeps resting liquidity up to its limit price, with unexecuted volume posted to the book; Market-to-Limit — executes only at the best opposing price level, with unexecuted volume posted at that price. Six Time in Force values: GFD (Day), GTC (Good Till Cancel), GTD (Good Till Date), GTT (Good Till Time), FOK (Fill or Kill), IOC (Immediate or Cancel); orders submitted with no TIF default to GFD. GTC/GTD/GTT are available only for dual-session options, not single-session Intraday/Overnight Options

sources.title: ASX 24 Trading Platform Guide（ASX 官网 PDF）

order_types.quote: ASX’s Trading Platform supports two order types, Limit and Market-to-Limit described in further detail below. ⋯ A Limit order is an order that executes against resting displayed liquidity at all permitted prices up to and including its Limit price. ⋯ A Market-to-Limit order is an order that executes against resting displayed liquidity only at the best opposing price. ⋯ Orders that are supplied with no TIF are defaulted to Day (GFD).

tick_size.zh: 以SPI 200股指期货为例，最小价格变动为1个指数点（A$25）；其余产品各自设有独立的最小变动单位（见合约规格表），本次未整理成统一档位表
tick_size.en: Example (SPI 200 Index Futures): minimum price movement is one index point (A$25); other products each have their own minimum price movement (see contract specifications), not consolidated into a unified table this round

sources.title: ASX 24合约规格总表（ASX 官网 PDF）

tick_size.quote: Minimum Price Movement: One index point (A$25)

contract_specs_note.zh: 以SPI 200股指期货为代表：合约乘数每指数点A$25（例如6,000点时合约价值A$150,000）；到期月份按3/6/9/12月循环最多六个季月，另加最近两个非季月合约；现金结算，最终结算价为最后交易日标的S&P/ASX 200指数的「特别开市报价」（Special Opening Quotation，以各成分股在最后交易日的首笔成交价计算）
contract_specs_note.en: Example (SPI 200 Index Futures): contract multiplier A$25 per index point (e.g. A$150,000 at 6,000 index points); expiry months follow a March/June/September/December quarterly cycle up to six quarter months ahead plus the nearest two non-quarterly expiry months; cash-settled, with the final settlement price being the Special Opening Quotation of the underlying S&P/ASX 200 Index on the Last Trading Day (calculated from each component stock's first traded price that day)

sources.title: ASX 24合约规格总表（ASX 官网 PDF）

contract_specs_note.quote: Contract Unit: Valued at A$25 per index point (e.g. A$150,000 at 6,000 index points). ⋯ Minimum Price Movement: One index point (A$25)

type.zh: 无逐日/逐时段价格限制区间；改用订单级别的异常订单阈值（AOT）机制作为价格保护手段，与现货市场同源，统一见ASIC《市场诚信规则》（MIRs）
type.en: No daily/session price-limit band; ASX's derivatives market instead uses order-level Anomalous Order Threshold (AOT) controls as its price safeguard — the same mechanism family as the cash market, under ASIC's common Market Integrity Rules (MIRs)

sources.title: Market volatility FAQs（ASX 官网）

type.quote: ASX does not use circuit breakers like those employed by some other international exchanges. ASIC applies a common set of market integrity rules (MIRs) for all securities and futures markets in Australia that all local market operators and their participants are required to adhere to. These rules include specifications about the use of Anomalous Order Thresholds (AOTs), rather than circuit breakers.

main_board.zh: 以SPI 200股指期货为例，AOT/NCR参考价为现货月合约30秒滚动成交量加权均价（SPI 200每15秒更新一次，其余合约每30秒更新一次）；QCR（合格撤销区间）下限>0.5%、上限<5%，超出5%即进入ETR（极端成交区间），触发交易所对该笔成交的强制复核/撤销
main_board.en: For SPI 200 Index Futures, the AOT/NCR Reference Price is a rolling 30-second VWAP of the spot-month contract (updated every 15 seconds for SPI 200, every 30 seconds for other contracts); the Qualifying Cancellation Range (QCR) runs from >0.5% (lower) to <5% (upper), and the Extreme Trade Range (ETR) starts at 5% deviation, triggering the Market Operator's mandatory review/cancellation of the trade

sources.title: ASX 24 Operating Rules 第三节（ASX 官网 PDF）

main_board.quote: there will be one VWAP (calculated over 30 seconds) Reference Price for each Contract dynamically updated every 15 seconds for the SPI 200 and 30 seconds for all other contracts. ⋯ SPI 200 See table above >0.5% < 5% 5%

other_boards.zh: 非指数类合约的NCR/QCR/ETR门槛以基点或绝对金额计（非百分比）：如90天银行承兑汇票期货 NCR 5.0基点、QCR 6.0–49.0基点、ETR起点50.0基点；东澳小麦期货 NCR A$5.00、QCR A$5.10–14.90、ETR起点A$15
other_boards.en: Non-index contracts' NCR/QCR/ETR thresholds are set in basis points or absolute currency amounts rather than percentages: e.g. 90 Day Bank Accepted Bill Futures — NCR 5.0 basis points, QCR 6.0–49.0 basis points, ETR starting at 50.0 basis points; Eastern Australia Wheat Futures — NCR A$5.00, QCR A$5.10–14.90, ETR starting at A$15

circuit_breaker.zh: ASX不对现货或衍生品市场使用「熔断」机制；ASIC统一《市场诚信规则》（MIRs）覆盖「全澳所有证券及期货市场」；ASX的衍生品市场以「监管性暂停」（Regulatory Halt）作为价格异常时人工重置参考价的工具，而非自动触发的熔断
circuit_breaker.en: ASX does not use 'circuit breakers' on either the cash or derivatives markets; ASIC's common Market Integrity Rules (MIRs) cover 'all securities and futures markets in Australia'; ASX's derivatives market instead uses a manually-invoked 'Regulatory Halt' to reset the reference price when prices become anomalous, rather than an automatic circuit breaker

sources.title: Market volatility FAQs（ASX 官网）

circuit_breaker.quote: ASX does not use circuit breakers like those employed by some other international exchanges. ASIC applies a common set of market integrity rules (MIRs) for all securities and futures markets in Australia that all local market operators and their participants are required to adhere to.

volatility_interruption.zh: 触发条件：连续交易期间若NCR/AOT区间发生位移、导致成交将落入ETR（构成ASIC《市场诚信规则》下的「ETR事件」），交易所将启动监管性暂停（Regulatory Halt）以重置ETR参考价及ETR/NCR/AOT区间；暂停后固定进入2分钟的开市前（Pre-Open）状态，之后再恢复Open交易；暂停期间该产品名下所有到期月份的期货与期权合约同步暂停
volatility_interruption.en: Trigger: if, during continuous trading, the NCR/AOT range shifts such that trades would occur within the ETR (an 'ETR Event' under the ASIC Market Integrity Rules), the Market Operator applies a Regulatory Halt to reset the ETR Reference Price and the ETR/NCR/AOT ranges; a fixed 2-minute Pre-Open state follows before Open trading resumes; the halt applies simultaneously to all expiry months of futures and options for that product

sources.title: ASX 24 Operating Rules 第三节（ASX 官网 PDF）

volatility_interruption.quote: during continuous trading the NCR/AOT range has moved such that trades would occur in the ETR (an ETR Event under the ASIC Market Integrity Rules) so that the ETR Reference Price, ETR and NCR/AOT range may be reset. ⋯ Following the Regulatory Halt, a Pre_Open period of 2 minutes will be applied before open trading resumes. ⋯ A Regulatory Halt in any Contract month of a product will result in a Regulatory Halt in all other Contract months and the complement option Contracts (if option Contracts are defined).

trading_halt_mechanism.zh: 监管性暂停（Regulatory Halt）会话状态：重置AOT参考价，随即转入2分钟的开市前（Pre-Open）状态；任一组合指令中若有一腿处于监管性暂停，该组合指令会被集中清空、新订单被拒绝；该状态由交易所（Market Operator）依职权发起，既用于ETR事件后的参考价重置，也用于开盘拍卖价或开盘成交价被判定无效时的补救——与现货市场中由上市实体依《上市规则》主动申请的交易暂停相比，触发主体与目的均不同
trading_halt_mechanism.en: Regulatory Halt session state: resets the AOT reference price and transitions into a fixed 2-minute Pre-Open state; combination orders with any leg subject to a Regulatory Halt are centrally purged and new orders rejected; the halt is invoked by the Market Operator at its own discretion, used both to reset the reference price after an ETR Event and as a remedy when the opening auction or opening transaction price is judged invalid — distinct in both trigger and purpose from the cash market's issuer-requested trading halt under the Listing Rules

sources.title: ASX 24 Trading Platform Guide（ASX 官网 PDF）
ASX 24 Operating Rules 第三节（ASX 官网 PDF）

trading_halt_mechanism.quote: Regulatory Halt: A pause in trading that resets the AOT reference price. Regulatory Halt transitions into a 2 minute Pre-Open state. Orders in any combination instrument with one or more legs in a Regulatory Halt will be centrally purged and new orders rejected.

block_trade.zh: 设Block Trade（大手交易）设施：以SPI 200股指期货为例，最低交易量200手（lots），可在日盘时段内及收盘后10分钟内协议成交，须于双方达成协议后10分钟内完成电子申报（夜盘时段协议成交则须在下一营业日悉尼时间上午9:30前申报）；其他合约品种各自设有独立最低门槛，如3年期国债期货2,000手、10年期国债期货750手、20年期国债期货500手
block_trade.en: ASX 24 has a Block Trade facility: for SPI 200 Index Futures, the minimum threshold is 200 lots; trades may be agreed during the Day Session and up to 10 minutes after its close, with electronic reporting required within 10 minutes of agreement (Night Session block trades must be reported by 9:30am Sydney time the next Business Day); other contracts carry their own minimum thresholds, e.g. 2,000 lots for 3-Year Bond Futures, 750 lots for 10-Year Bond Futures, 500 lots for 20-Year Bond Futures

sources.title: ASX 24 Operating Rules 第四节（订单录入与交易）（ASX 官网 PDF）

block_trade.quote: SPI 200 Index Closest quarterly Block trades may be agreed Block trades may be agreed 200 lots 0.1 ⋯ Electronic reporting must be completed within 10 minutes of agreement between the parties

market_maker_scheme.zh: ASX 24按产品类别设有正式的做市商安排（Market Maker Arrangements），由交易所与获委任做市商签订商业协议，规定报价时间占比、最低流动性与最大价差：以Mini SPI 200股指期货为例，要求在合约可交易时间的80%内于最近四个合约月持续双边报价，最优买卖价差不超过标的SPI 200股指期货1个指数点；SPI 200期权做市商则要求在一个日历月内累计70%时间提供报价（其中20个期权系列持续报价占50%时间、回应询价请求占50%时间），最低流动性15张合约
market_maker_scheme.en: ASX 24 has formal Market Maker Arrangements by product category, under commercial agreements between ASX and appointed market makers specifying quoting-time percentage, minimum liquidity and maximum spread: for Mini SPI 200 Index Futures, market makers must generally provide continuous two-way quotes in the front four months for 80% of the time the contract is tradeable, with a best bid/offer spread no wider than 1 index point around the SPI 200 Index Futures contract; for Options on SPI 200 Index Futures, market makers must generally quote for an aggregate of 70% of the time in a calendar month (providing continuous quotes in 20 option series per class for 50% of the time, and responding to 50% of quote requests), with minimum liquidity of 15 contracts in an options series

sources.title: 做市商安排总览页（ASX 官网）
指数衍生品做市商安排（含SPI 200期货期权）（ASX 官网）

market_maker_scheme.quote: Generally, for an aggregate of 70% of the time in a calendar month: ⋯ provide continuous quotes in 20 option series per class for 50% of the time the contract is available for trading in a calendar month, and ⋯ respond to 50% of requests for quote during a calendar month ⋯ 15 contracts in an options series ⋯ Generally provide continuous two-way quotes in the front four months for 80% of the time that the contract is available to be traded ⋯ Best bid/offer spread of 1 index point above/below SPI 200 Index Futures contract

margin_practice_note.zh: 衍生品端保证金与清算由ASX Clear (Futures)负责：采用SPAN（Standard Portfolio Analysis of Risk）组合风险方法计算初始保证金，基于「价格扫描范围」（PSR）与「波动率扫描范围」（VSR）构造16种「假设」情景逐日计算风险数组（risk array）；每个结算日终，对House账户与Client账户分别计收当日变动保证金（variation margin）及用于下一结算日的初始保证金（initial margin）；另设跨商品价差减让（inter-commodity spread concession）
margin_practice_note.en: On the derivatives side, margining and clearing is handled by ASX Clear (Futures): it applies the SPAN (Standard Portfolio Analysis of Risk) portfolio-risk methodology to calculate initial margin, using a Price Scan Range (PSR) and Volatility Scan Range (VSR) to construct 16 'what if' scenarios and calculate a daily risk array; at the end of each clearing day, ASX Clear (Futures) charges the House and Client accounts a daily variation margin and an initial margin for the next settlement day; inter-commodity spread concessions are also available

sources.title: ASX Clear (Futures)（ASX 官网）
ASX Clear (Futures) SPAN保证金算例（ASX 官网 PDF）

margin_practice_note.quote: In calculating the profit or loss a portfolio will make, SPAN uses 16 'what if' scenarios where futures prices and volatilities are altered to varying degrees based on the 'Price Scan Range' and 'Volatility Scan Range' set by ASX Clear (Futures) and defined below.

connect_schemes.detail: 未见ASX 24与境外衍生品交易所之间的正式互联互通/联合挂牌安排；ASX 24虽同时挂牌澳元与新西兰元计价合约（如NZ 90天银行汇票期货），但两者共用同一交易平台与同一结算主体ASX Clear (Futures)，属同一交易所内的多币种产品线，非跨交易所连接机制，不作为该字段内容填入。

boards.name_zh: 官方上市名单（无板块分层）
boards.financial_threshold: 利润测试：过去3年累计经营利润A$100万+最近12个月经营利润A$50万；或资产测试：净有形资产A$400万，或市值A$1500万；另需至少300名非关联股东各持有价值≥A$2,000的证券包，且上市时自由流通量不低于20%
boards.target_companies: 无板块分层结构，唯一的准入名单，覆盖各类规模与行业的企业
已在合格境外交易所上市的公司（新西兰公司门槛更低），主要遵守母国上市地规则，豁免大部分ASX上市规则

review_system.zh: 披露为本的准入审核制度：满足量化门槛（利润或资产二选一）+股东分布/自由流通量要求即可申请，ASX对适合性另有实质审核权，不完全对应注册制/核准制的二分
review_system.en: Disclosure-based admission regime: applicants meeting quantitative thresholds (profit or assets test) plus spread/free-float requirements may apply; ASX retains substantive discretion over suitability, not a clean fit for the registration-based/approval-based dichotomy
review_system.detail: 与港交所案例（见hk-hkex.yml review_system字段）相同，是矩阵受控词表`review_system`覆盖面不足的又一例证，记入OPEN-QUESTIONS。

sources.title: ASX Listing Rules Chapter 1（ASX 官网 PDF）

transfer_between_boards.zh: 不适用：ASX无板块分层结构，仅ASX Listing与ASX Foreign Exempt Listing两类不同准入路径，两者间转换未见专门规则页说明
transfer_between_boards.en: N/A: ASX has no tiered board structure; only two distinct admission categories (ASX Listing vs ASX Foreign Exempt Listing) exist, and no dedicated rule page on switching between them was located

sources.title: ASX Listing Rules Chapter 1（ASX 官网 PDF，准入规则通篇未见板块间转换条款）

continuing_obligations.zh: 持续披露（Listing Rule 3.1，见regulation.disclosure_requirements）；按年度/半年度（部分矿业及油气勘探公司加季度）提交财务报告；年度上市费须按期缴纳
continuing_obligations.en: Continuous disclosure (Listing Rule 3.1, see regulation.disclosure_requirements); annual/half-yearly (and for certain mining/oil & gas entities, quarterly) financial reporting; timely payment of annual listing fees

sources.title: Matters regulated by ASIC vs matters regulated by ASX（ASX 官网 PDF）

continuing_obligations.quote: Chapter 3 for listed entities to disclose various matters to ASX in a timely manner including, importantly, their obligation under Listing Rule 3.1 ... Chapter 4 for listed entities to lodge annual, half-yearly and, in some cases, quarterly financial statements and reports with ASX by certain dates

suspension_resumption.zh: ASX可依职权随时暂停证券报价，典型触发情形包括：为防止无序或信息不对称市场、实体未按期提交文件或未缴纳上市费（次一营业日起暂停）；暂停不等同于终止报价，可无需重新申请即恢复
suspension_resumption.en: ASX may suspend quotation of securities at any time on its own initiative, typically to prevent a disorderly or uninformed market, or where an entity fails to lodge documents or pay listing fees by the due date (suspension from the next business day); suspension is distinct from ending quotation and securities may be reinstated without a fresh application

sources.title: ASX Listing Rules Chapter 17（ASX 官网 PDF）

suspension_resumption.quote: It is necessary to suspend quotation to prevent a disorderly or uninformed market. ... Securities that are suspended, or subject to a trading halt or interruption, may be reinstated to quotation without a fresh application.

delisting_conditions.zh: ASX可依职权将实体从官方上市名单移除，主要情形包括：实体无法或不愿遵守上市规则、已无任何报价证券，或ASX认为存在其他合理理由
delisting_conditions.en: ASX may remove an entity from the official list where, in ASX's opinion: the entity is unable or unwilling to comply with a Listing Rule, has no quoted securities, or removal is appropriate for some other reason

sources.title: ASX Listing Rules Chapter 17（ASX 官网 PDF）

delisting_conditions.quote: ASX may remove an entity from the official list if, in ASX's opinion, any of the following applies. The entity is unable or unwilling to comply with, or breaks, a listing rule. ... The entity has no quoted securities. It is appropriate for some other reason.

delisting_process.zh: 可依实体请求移除（ASX有权要求满足附加条件），或由ASX依职权移除；未按期缴纳年度上市费的，于到期日后第20个营业日收盘时自动移除；移除生效日通常为ASX指定日期的收盘时点
delisting_process.en: Removal may occur at the entity's request (subject to ASX's discretion to impose conditions) or on ASX's own initiative; failure to pay the annual listing fee triggers automatic removal at the close of trading on the 20th business day after the due date; removal generally takes effect at the close of trading on a date ASX determines

sources.title: ASX Listing Rules Chapter 17（ASX 官网 PDF）

delisting_process.quote: ASX may at any time remove an entity from the official list at the request of the entity. ... If an entity does not pay an annual listing fee as required under rule 16.5, ASX will remove the entity from the official list at the close of trading on the 20th business day after the due date.

sources.title: S&P/ASX indices 101（ASX 官网博客）

items.name_zh: 澳大利亚全普通股指数
items.description: 以三个月平均总市值(TMC)衡量的市值最大500家公司，非自由流通量调整口径；常被视为「大盘」代名词但成分股数远小于ASX全部约2,000家上市公司
澳大利亚股市的「基准」指数，众多基金以此为业绩比较基准，亦是大型ETF的跟踪标的
在XJO 200家基础上再加100家规模较小但具流动性的公司

settlement_cycle.zh: T+2（自2016年起实行）。此后ASX成立T+1工作组研究进一步压缩至T+1的可行性，2024年4月23日发布行业白皮书；官方页面明确称之为「潜在改革」，处于征求行业反馈阶段，未见官方确认的正式切换日期
settlement_cycle.en: T+2, in effect since 2016. ASX has since run a T+1 Working Group studying a further move to T+1, publishing an industry whitepaper on 23 April 2024; the official page explicitly describes this as a 'potential' change under industry consultation, with no confirmed transition date found
settlement_cycle.detail: T+1相关页面（considerations for accelerating cash equities settlement）明确使用「potential move」「considerations」等用语，未见官方承诺具体生效日期，故本条不填写具体的T+1预期切换年份，仅记录现状与在研状态，避免把「在讨论」误标为「已确定」。

sources.title: Cash market clearing（ASX 官网）
T+1 Settlement Cycle（ASX 官网，改革研究现状说明）
History（ASX 官网，"2016 - T+2 settlement...commenced"）

settlement_cycle.quote: 2016 - T+2 settlement of sharemarket trades commenced. ... The resulting transactions are sent to ASX Settlement for settlement in CHESS on the morning of T+2. ... References to a potential move to T+1 settlement for the Australian cash equity market means settlement one business day after the trade date (T) (that is, T+1 is trade date plus one business day). ... On 23 April 2024, ASX published an industry whitepaper following on from the establishment of the T+1 Working Group.

ccp_name.zh: ASX Clear（现货市场证券/权证/结构性产品/计息证券的中央对手方）
ccp_name.en: ASX Clear (central counterparty for equities, warrants, structured products and interest rate securities)
ccp_name.detail: 清算流程含新设(novation)：原交易双方合约被替换为清算参与者与ASX Clear之间的两笔独立合约，ASX Clear成为每笔买方交易的卖方、每笔卖方交易的买方。

sources.title: Cash market clearing（ASX 官网）

ccp_name.quote: Once accepted by ASX Clear, each cash market transaction or derivatives market contract is novated – replaced with two separate transactions or contracts between the clearing participants and ASX Clear as the Central Counterparty (CCP).

csd_name.zh: ASX Settlement，透过结算与股权分登记电子系统（CHESS）运作
csd_name.en: ASX Settlement, operating via the Clearing House Electronic Sub-register System (CHESS)
csd_name.detail: CHESS将结算服务与电子分登记系统合二为一，投资者可选择CHESS分登记或发行人保荐分登记两种持有方式，前者以投资者本人名义直接持有证券。

sources.title: ASX Settlement（ASX 官网）

csd_name.quote: The settlement system and electronic securities depository for cash equities, warrants and other equity related securities traded in Australia ... We conduct settlement through the Clearing House Electronic Sub-register System (CHESS).

delivery_method.detail: 本文件聚焦ASX现货股票市场，products章节所列品类（股票/ETP/权证/A-REITs/LICs/计息证券）均为现货或现金结算的结构性产品；衍生品市场ASX 24的实物/现金交割规则不在本文件覆盖范围（见group_id说明）。这是对本文件自身products章节的内部推断，非逐产品交割规则页的直接证据。

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网，页面标题本身即以"Cash market"指称本文件覆盖的现货市场）

investor_structure.zh: 以S&P/ASX 300成分股为例，约70%股本由机构投资者持有、30%为散户；其中45%的股本由境外机构投资者持有——该数字针对S&P/ASX 300成分股口径，非整个ASX市场的正式统计，仅作参考
investor_structure.en: Among S&P/ASX 300 constituents, roughly 70% of share capital is held by institutions vs 30% retail; of this, 45% of share capital is held by overseas institutions — this figure is specific to S&P/ASX 300 constituents, not an official whole-market statistic

sources.title: S&P/ASX indices 101（ASX 官网博客）

investor_structure.quote: 70% of the share capital in the XKO is institutional vs 30% retail. Furthermore, 45% of the share capital is held by overseas institutions.

foreign_access_channel.zh: 无类似QFII式的额度审批通道；境外投资者原则上可直接开户交易，仅在触及FIRB申报门槛（一般持股≥20%「实质利益」或外国政府投资者的任何直接投资）时须向财政部申报，见regulation.foreign_ownership_limit
foreign_access_channel.en: No QFII-style quota approval channel; foreign investors may generally trade directly, with notification to the Treasurer required only once FIRB thresholds are triggered (generally a 20% 'substantial interest' for private investors, or any direct investment for foreign government investors), see regulation.foreign_ownership_limit

sources.title: Guidance Note 7 - Business Investments（外国投资审查委员会 FIRB，PDF）

membership_structure.zh: 分层参与者体系：Trading Participant（交易参与者）/ Clearing Participant（清算参与者）/ Settlement Participant（结算参与者），角色可分离亦可由同一机构兼任
membership_structure.en: Tiered participant structure: Trading Participant / Clearing Participant / Settlement Participant, which may be separate roles or held by the same institution
membership_structure.detail: 1999年ASX引入第三方清算，允许市场参与者选择仅从事交易或仅从事清算，见overview.history。本条基于Operating Rules全篇反复出现的角色术语归纳，非某一条款的单一定义性引用。

sources.title: ASX Operating Rules Section 3（ASX 官网 PDF）

trading_system_name.zh: ASX Trade（现行交易系统）；1987年引入的前身系统为Stock Exchange Automated Trading System（SEATS），已被取代
trading_system_name.en: ASX Trade (current trading system); predecessor Stock Exchange Automated Trading System (SEATS) introduced in 1987 has since been replaced

sources.title: Cash market trading hours（ASX 官网）
History（ASX 官网）

trading_system_name.quote: Brokers enter orders into ASX Trade in preparation for the market opening. ... 1987 - The Australian Stock Exchange Limited (ASX) was formed on 1 April ... ASX's Stock Exchange Automated Trading System (SEATS) was introduced in October, the day before the global stock market crash.

access_methods.detail: 官网导航提及ASX Net、ASX Colo OnDemand、Australian Liquidity Centre(ALC)等接入/托管服务名称，但本轮未深入抓取其各自专门说明页，留空。

major_outage_history.zh: CHESS更换项目重大失败案例：2017年启动以分布式账本技术(Digital Asset)替换CHESS的项目，2022年11月17日叫停，注销约2.45-2.55亿澳元（税前）项目成本；2026年联邦法院裁定ASX因2022年2月10日「项目进展良好」的误导性市场公告需支付2050万澳元罚款（另加300万澳元诉讼费用），是ASIC对ASX自身提起并胜诉的执法案例
major_outage_history.en: Major CHESS replacement project failure: a distributed-ledger (Digital Asset) based CHESS replacement project launched in 2017 was paused on 17 November 2022, derecognising approximately A$245-255 million (pre-tax) in project costs; in 2026 the Federal Court ordered ASX to pay a A$20.5 million penalty (plus A$3 million in ASIC's costs) for a misleading 10 February 2022 market announcement that the project was 'progressing well' — an ASIC enforcement action against ASX itself

sources.title: 26-143MR ASX ordered to pay $20.5 million penalty for misleading conduct relating to CHESS replacement project（ASIC 官网）

major_outage_history.quote: The Federal Court has ordered ASX Limited (ASX) to pay a $20.5 million penalty for its misleading statement about the progress of its CHESS replacement project. The penalty decision follows ASX's admission that its 10 February 2022 market announcement stating the CHESS replacement project was “progressing well” was misleading and exposed market participants to the risk of financial harm. ... ASX was also ordered to pay $3 million toward ASIC's costs. ... On 17 November 2022, ASX paused the project and derecognised approximately $245-$255 million (pre-tax) in its own project costs.

exchange_fees.detail: 本轮找到的费率数字集中在清算环节（见clearing_fees），未核实ASX Trade成交本身（非清算环节）的交易费率表具体数字，留空。

clearing_fees.zh: 现货市场股票及投资产品清算费：成交金额的0.225个基点（0.00225%），从价计费
clearing_fees.en: Cash market clearing fee for equities and investment products: 0.225 basis points (0.00225%) of executed trade value, charged ad valorem
clearing_fees.detail: 权证、计息证券适用更高费率0.35个基点（0.0035%）；另有交叉盘登记费0.10个基点（$5封顶）；ASX运营现货市场清算结算收入分成机制，超年度增长门槛部分与清算结算参与者对半分享。

sources.title: ASX Clear 现货市场清算费率表（ASX 官网 PDF）

clearing_fees.quote: Transaction Clearing Fee for Equities and Investment Products Calculated at 0.00225% of executed Trade Value for message: 164 1-Jul-16 Ad valorem of 0.225 Basis Points

stamp_duty.detail: 本轮未找到直接官方来源确认ASX二级市场股票交易本身的印花税现状（第三方检索线索显示上市证券转让印花税早在GST推行的1990年代末已获各州豁免，但未逐条核实原始州税务条例或政府间协议文本，不采信WebSearch摘要，留空待核实），见OPEN-QUESTIONS。

dividend_withholding_tax.detail: 草稿印象：澳大利亚有股息预扣税但设有独特的「分红抵免」(franking credit/imputation)制度，已完全抵免的分红部分对本地居民无预扣税——一般性知识，未附官方来源核实具体税率与适用条件，留空。

fx_risk_note.zh: 澳元为自由浮动货币，与大宗商品价格及利差交易情绪相关性较高，波动性通常高于美元/欧元等主要货币，但未附官方来源量化，属一般性知识
fx_risk_note.en: The Australian dollar floats freely and is relatively correlated with commodity prices and carry-trade sentiment, typically more volatile than major currencies such as USD/EUR; general knowledge, not sourced to an official quote

regulatory_change_risk_note.zh: CHESS更换项目自2017年启动、2022年叫停重启（现由TCS承接）、2026年ASX本身因误导性市场公告被联邦法院处以2050万澳元罚款——展示了本所核心结算基础设施改造项目的执行与信息披露风险，详见infrastructure.major_outage_history
regulatory_change_risk_note.en: The CHESS replacement saga (launched 2017, paused 2022, now with TCS) culminated in a 2026 Federal Court penalty of A$20.5 million against ASX itself for misleading market disclosure — illustrating execution and disclosure risk around the exchange's core settlement infrastructure overhaul, see infrastructure.major_outage_history

sources.title: 26-143MR ASX ordered to pay $20.5 million penalty for misleading conduct relating to CHESS replacement project（ASIC 官网）

regulatory_change_risk_note.quote: The Federal Court has ordered ASX Limited (ASX) to pay a $20.5 million penalty for its misleading statement about the progress of its CHESS replacement project.

enforcement_note.zh: ASIC对ASX自身提起并胜诉的2026年CHESS误导性陈述民事处罚案（2050万澳元）显示监管执法环境覆盖交易所运营商本身、并非只针对上市公司或市场参与者；法院同时强调该判罚旨在警示所有披露主体不得就重大项目进展做误导性陈述
enforcement_note.en: ASIC's 2026 civil penalty action against ASX itself over misleading CHESS project disclosures (A$20.5m) shows the enforcement environment reaches the exchange operator, not only listed companies or market participants; the Court stressed the penalty was meant to deter misleading statements about major project progress across all disclosing entities

sources.title: 26-143MR ASX ordered to pay $20.5 million penalty for misleading conduct relating to CHESS replacement project（ASIC 官网）

enforcement_note.quote: 26-143MR ASX ordered to pay $20.5 million penalty for misleading conduct relating to CHESS replacement project ... The Federal Court has ordered ASX Limited (ASX) to pay a $20.5 million penalty for its misleading statement about the progress of its CHESS replacement project. ... it was 'also necessary that the market as a whole understands that misleading announcements made by disclosing entities about their operations will be the subject of significant penalties and there is a need to deter other listed entities from making misleading announcements about the progress of significant projects in which they may be engaging, including where the completion of that project involves third parties.'
